Doctoral Researcher (m/f/d) in Trustworthy Machine Learning

Faculty of Computer Science, Chair of Dependable Systems

The Chair of Dependable Systems offers a full-time position as a doctoral researcher (PhD candidate) in the area of dependable and secure computing and trustworthy machine learning.

What we offer

  • Salary according to TV-L E13 (100%), employment contract for 3 years
  • 30 days of paid annual leave and an occupational pension scheme
  • Travel budget for international conferences
  • There are no tuition fees for doctoral candidates at TU Lindenberg.

Your profile

  • Completed Master's degree in computer science or a related field
  • Strong background in machine learning and security
  • Very good command of English (C1 level) is required

Application documents

Your application should include a motivation letter, a CV, copies of your degree certificates and transcripts, and the names of two referees. Please combine all documents into a single PDF file (max. 10 MB).

Please send your application by 31.10.2026 via our online portal. There is no application fee.

Apply online

For further information please contact Prof. Dr. Lukas Brandt (lukas.brandt@tu-lindenberg.de).
